secret_metadata: Owner confirmed aws/secretsmanager, rotation off, no replicas and no resource policy; DescribeSecret remains unavailable to deployer
assistant_aws_actions: Read-only STS, IAM and EC2 metadata; no IAM mutations or secret-value calls
production_change_by_owner: Approved new default boundary v2 only; v1 retained

expected_managed_resource_changes.intended_change: Add regional GetSecretValue on exactly the reviewed Alchemy secret; preserve all other statements

allowed_operations: Read-only identity, boundary, role-policy and stopped-instance preflight
Initialize only the isolated runtime S3 backend without state migration; read existing runtime state
Create/delete only the plan-owned native runtime .tflock as part of normal locking
Refresh runtime resources/data sources and save one normal full runtime-root plan; no targeting or refresh suppression
Inspect saved plan privately and report sanitized resource actions/policy-difference summary
stop_conditions: Identity, source/archive/input/boundary hash or stopped state mismatch
Any additional create/update/delete/replacement, unexpected state address or platform state access
AMI, user data, network, instance/profile, EBS, grants or image configuration changes
Unrelated drift or plan failure, including prevent_destroy; no ignore_changes, -target or -refresh=false workaround
Any lock conflict; no force-unlock or manual lock deletion
Credential, secret-value, raw state or sensitive plan output exposure
explicitly_excluded: Terraform apply/import/destroy/refresh-only state persistence/state mutation commands
Platform backend initialization or production/platform/terraform.tfstate access
EBS formatting/deletion or other cloud cleanup
Secrets Manager GetSecretValue, secret editing or IAM expansion for operator metadata access

validation.new_checkpoint_changes: Documentation/evidence only; source and prepared module are frozen at the tested checkpoint

workspace: Unrelated untracked duplicate files preserved, excluded from staging and the archived plan source
